# TravizPeru
Full version: https://travizperu.com/llms-full.txt

> TravizPeru designs private, tailor-made luxury travel in Peru, created by Francisco Arriz Barrantes from Lima (22 years in Peru tourism, APOTUR member AP030-11). Every trip is private and bespoke; prices are on request (quoted per trip).

## What we offer
- Private, tailor-made journeys in Peru: Lima, Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Lake Titicaca and the Amazon.
- Three journey styles (price on request):
  - [Andean Classic](https://travizperu.com/tours/andean-classic/): from 5 days. The Sacred Valley, a private Machu Picchu guided tour and Cusco, 5-star hotels.
  - [Complete Peru](https://travizperu.com/tours/complete-peru/): from 10 days. Lima, Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu and Lake Titicaca, 5-star hotels and internal flights.
  - [Grand Expedition](https://travizperu.com/tours/grand-expedition/): from 15 days. The Andes, Machu Picchu and the Amazon rainforest, luxury lodges, 100% bespoke.
- [Private Machu Picchu tour](https://travizperu.com/private-machu-picchu-tour/) ([español](https://travizperu.com/es/tour-privado-machu-picchu/): entradas oficiales, trenes, altitud y el cierre de febrero de 2026 del Camino Inca), [honeymoons](https://travizperu.com/peru-honeymoon/), [family trips](https://travizperu.com/peru-family-private-tour/), [10-day itinerary](https://travizperu.com/tailor-made-peru-itinerary-10-days/), [Christmas & New Year at Machu Picchu](https://travizperu.com/christmas-new-year-machu-picchu/).
- [Groups](https://travizperu.com/groups/): congresses, incentives, gala dinners and educational student trips.
- [Incentive travel for groups of 12 or more](https://travizperu.com/incentive-travel-peru/) ([español](https://travizperu.com/es/viajes-de-incentivo-peru/)): private logistics, guides, experiences and private dinners for companies, incentives, retreats, celebrations and affinity groups.
- [Peru DMC for luxury travel advisors](https://travizperu.com/travel-advisors/) ([español](https://travizperu.com/es/agentes-de-viaje/)): bespoke private itineraries, private guides and on-the-ground support. Rates are not published on the website. Email travizperu@gmail.com.

## Beyond Peru (Otros destinos)
- [Iguazú Falls, Buenos Aires, Rio de Janeiro and Costa Rica](https://travizperu.com/beyond-peru/) ([español](https://travizperu.com/es/mas-alla-de-peru/)): private trips on their own or combined with Peru.
- [Costa Rica](https://travizperu.com/costa-rica/): an exclusive rainforest villa in Manuel Antonio for groups and families, birding, Peru + Costa Rica combinations. The combined private journey is [Peru and Costa Rica](https://travizperu.com/peru-costa-rica/) ([español](https://travizperu.com/es/peru-y-costa-rica/)).

No official 2027 sale date is published. Tickets are requested once you confirm, subject to availability.
- [Is Peru good for a honeymoon?](https://travizperu.com/blog/is-peru-good-for-a-honeymoon/) and [¿Es Perú bueno para una luna de miel?](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/es-peru-bueno-para-luna-de-miel/).

Iguazú and Buenos Aires are offered on Beyond Peru. Patagonia is Peru plus coordinated timing. Day counts are suggestions.
- [Peru and Galápagos in one trip](https://travizperu.com/blog/peru-and-galapagos-itinerary/) and [Perú y Galápagos en un solo viaje](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/peru-y-galapagos-itinerario/).
- [Machu Picchu in December and January (rainy season)](https://travizperu.com/blog/machu-picchu-december-january-rainy-season/) and [Machu Picchu en diciembre y enero (temporada de lluvias)](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/machu-picchu-diciembre-enero-temporada-de-lluvias/).
- [Machu Picchu train status](https://travizperu.com/machu-picchu-train-status/)
- [El Niño 2026–2027 and your Peru trip](https://travizperu.com/el-nino/) (English) and [El Niño y tu viaje a Perú](https://travizperu.com/es/el-nino/) (español): what ENFEN, SENAMHI and NOAA say, updated 27 October 2026.
- [Is El Niño a risk for your Peru trip?](https://travizperu.com/blog/el-nino-peru-travel-2026/) and [¿El Niño es un riesgo para tu viaje a Perú?](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/el-nino-viaje-peru-2026/).
- [Machu Picchu for Seniors](https://travizperu.com/blog/machu-picchu-for-seniors/) and [Machu Picchu para mayores](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/machu-picchu-para-adultos-mayores/).
- [Peru with Grandchildren](https://travizperu.com/blog/peru-with-grandchildren/) and [Perú con nietos](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/peru-con-nietos/).
- [Best Time to Visit Peru](https://travizperu.com/blog/best-time-to-visit-peru/)
- [Peru Altitude Sickness: How to Prepare](https://travizperu.com/blog/peru-altitude-sickness-luxury-trip/)
- [Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain](https://travizperu.com/blog/huayna-picchu-or-machu-picchu-mountain/) and [¿Huayna Picchu o Montaña Machu Picchu?](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/huayna-picchu-o-montana-machu-picchu/). Route 3-A (Circuit 3) is the shorter, steeper summit; Route 1-A (Circuit 1) is the longer panoramic walk, with Salkantay and Pumasillo named by Tu Boleto. In 2026 the annex lists 400 and 350 places a day. From 1 January 2027 the hours change under RM 407-2026-MC and RM 408-2026-MC. Tickets are requested once you confirm, subject to availability.
- [Cusco or the Sacred Valley first](https://travizperu.com/blog/sacred-valley-or-cusco-first/) and [¿Cusco o Valle Sagrado primero?](https://travizperu.com/es/blog/valle-sagrado-o-cusco-primero/). Most private trips sleep in the valley before Cusco. Published altitudes differ by the point measured: Cusco 3,399 m (PROMPERÚ; INEI also lists 3,439 m and 3,414 m); Urubamba 2,871 m (PROMPERÚ); Ollantaytambo 2,851 m (MINCETUR) and 2,871 m (INEI); Machupicchu Pueblo 2,040 m (district municipality) and 2,092 m (INEI); Machu Picchu sanctuary 2,430 m (UNESCO). Tickets are requested once you confirm, subject to availability.
- [Private vs Group Tour in Peru](https://travizperu.com/blog/private-vs-group-tour-peru/)
- [First Trip to Peru: Planning Checklist](https://travizperu.com/blog/first-trip-to-peru-checklist/)
